tool_args.rationale: The pilot covers H ≤ 0.48, whereas the target is H = 23.8. A slow-horizon probe directly tests and calibrates the predicted reversal and helps distinguish the authorized adaptation mechanisms.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit dual-horizon adaptation from pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five short-horizon rows do not reliably identify the slow component or its long-horizon reversal.
Finer short-horizon observations would be less informative about the slow component at the target horizon.
It is not relevant to identifying the horizon response.
